name: GRASS3-the-placer-reads-a-bilinear-patch-again-so-blades-float-on-hills
old: const h = quadValueAt(h00, h10, h01, h11, ax, az, quadCutsSeNw(heightmapData, qx, qz, stride));
note: TERRAIN-CUT (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the line it mutates now carries the quad's own cut (terrainQuadCut.js).

name: GRASS3-the-quad-is-cut-on-the-other-diagonal
old: const h = quadValueAt(h00, h10, h01, h11, ax, az, quadCutsSeNw(heightmapData, qx, qz, stride));
new: const h = quadValueAt(h00, h10, h01, h11, ax, az, !quadCutsSeNw(heightmapData, qx, qz, stride));
note: TERRAIN-CUT (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the line it mutates now carries the quad's own cut (terrainQuadCut.js).

name: GRASS3-the-height-ignores-the-rings-stride-so-far-ground-is-read-at-the-wrong-resolution
old:
const worldHeight = MAX_TERRAIN_HEIGHT * STREAMING_TERRAIN_SCALE;
  const quad = (TERRAIN_SIZE / (hDim - 1)) * stride;
new:
const worldHeight = MAX_TERRAIN_HEIGHT * STREAMING_TERRAIN_SCALE;
  const quad = TERRAIN_SIZE / (hDim - 1);

name: GRASS3-the-corner-samples-are-one-apart-rather-than-a-stride-apart
old:
const x0 = qx * stride, z0 = qz * stride, x1 = x0 + stride, z1 = z0 + stride;
  const h00 = at(x0, z0), h10 = at(x1, z0), h01 = at(x0, z1), h11 = at(x1, z1);
new:
const x0 = qx * stride, z0 = qz * stride, x1 = x0 + 1, z1 = z0 + 1;
  const h00 = at(x0, z0), h10 = at(x1, z0), h01 = at(x0, z1), h11 = at(x1, z1);

name: GRASS3-the-heightmap-is-read-z-major-so-the-ground-is-transposed
old:
const at = (x, z) => heightmapData[Math.max(0, Math.min(hDim - 1, x)) * hDim
    + Math.max(0, Math.min(hDim - 1, z))];
new:
const at = (x, z) => heightmapData[Math.max(0, Math.min(hDim - 1, z)) * hDim
    + Math.max(0, Math.min(hDim - 1, x))];

name: GRASS3-the-grass-placer-goes-back-to-its-own-bilinear-read
note: FLORA-GROUND (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - the grass reads the ground's one law, walkGroundAt (stride 1, the ring it stands on), where it read surfaceHeightAt at its pixel's stride.
